$comment: Licensed under CC-BY-4.0. An additional login on a device. The device record keeps its main login; every other user gets a record of this type with a link to the device. The target is a record that names the type `device` (a Wi-Fi access point or an OpenWrt device names it as well), so no device type has to be listed here.
title: Device account
description: An additional login on a device, linked to the device's record.

UserName.description: The user name of the login.

URL.description: Where the login is used, if it is not the device's own admin address.

device.description: The device this login belongs to.

valid_until.description: The day the record stops being valid. Empty means it does not expire.
